# Health Tech Career Roadmaps - Full Content Index
# https://roadmaps.ehoneahobed.com
# For LLM consumption: This file provides structured metadata about all roadmaps.
# For full content, visit each roadmap URL directly.

## Roadmap: Clinical Data Analyst
URL: /r/clinical-data-analyst
Difficulty: Moderate
Timeline: 3 to 6 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to clinical data analyst roles
Key Certifications: CHDA (AHIMA), RHIT (AHIMA), Epic Certification, Tableau Desktop Specialist
Key Skills: SQL, Python/R, Tableau/Power BI, statistical analysis, healthcare data standards
Clinical Advantage: You already understand clinical workflows, medical terminology, and data quality issues that pure data analysts spend months learning.

## Roadmap: Health Informatics Analyst
URL: /r/health-informatics-analyst
Difficulty: Moderate
Timeline: 3 to 6 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to health informatics analyst roles
Key Certifications: CPHIMS, Epic/Cerner certification, NI-BC (for nurses)
Key Skills: EHR systems, data analysis, workflow optimization, clinical documentation improvement
Clinical Advantage: You have lived inside the systems you will be optimizing. Your clinical workflow knowledge is irreplaceable.

## Roadmap: EHR Implementation Specialist
URL: /r/ehr-implementation-specialist
Difficulty: Low (shortest bridge)
Timeline: 1 to 3 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to EHR implementation specialist roles
Key Certifications: Epic (70%+ of postings), Cerner (60%+), Meditech (50%+), all employer-sponsored post-hire
Key Skills: EHR configuration, workflow mapping, end-user training, go-live support
Clinical Advantage: This is the shortest bridge from clinical to tech. You are the subject matter expert vendors need.

## Roadmap: Health Tech Product Manager
URL: /r/health-tech-product-manager
Difficulty: High
Timeline: 6 to 12 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to health tech product management roles
Key Certifications: CSPO (15-20% of postings), Reforge courses (most respected, no credential)
Key Skills: User research, PRD writing, stakeholder management, product strategy, Agile/Scrum
Clinical Advantage: You understand clinical workflows, regulatory constraints, and stakeholder complexity. PM hiring is portfolio-driven, not certification-driven.

## Roadmap: Healthcare AI/ML Engineer
URL: /r/healthcare-ai-ml-engineer
Difficulty: Very High (most technically demanding)
Timeline: 12 to 18 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to healthcare AI/ML engineering roles
Key Certifications: AWS ML Specialty (35-50% of postings), Google Cloud ML Engineer (38%)
Key Skills: Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, clinical NLP, medical imaging AI, FHIR/HL7, MLOps
Clinical Advantage: You understand the data (messy EHR data), the users (clinicians), and the safety requirements (HIPAA, bias detection) in ways pure data scientists cannot match.

## Roadmap: Health Tech Regulatory & Compliance Analyst
URL: /r/health-tech-regulatory-compliance-analyst
Difficulty: Moderate
Timeline: 4 to 8 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to regulatory affairs and compliance roles in health tech
Key Certifications: RAC (gold standard), CHC, CHPC, ISO 13485 Lead Auditor
Key Skills: FDA SaMD regulation, HIPAA compliance, ISO 13485 QMS, risk management (ISO 14971), AI/ML device regulation, EU AI Act
Clinical Advantage: You understand the clinical context that regulations are designed to protect. Your adverse event reporting, accreditation experience, and documentation discipline translate directly to regulatory work.

## Roadmap: Health Data Analyst
URL: /r/health-data-analyst
Difficulty: Moderate
Timeline: 4 to 8 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to population health, payer analytics, and quality measurement roles
Key Certifications: CHDA (AHIMA, gold standard), Tableau Desktop Specialist, Google Data Analytics Certificate, RHIT
Key Skills: SQL, Python, Tableau/Power BI, claims data analysis, HEDIS quality measures, CMS Star Ratings, population health analytics, SDOH integration
Clinical Advantage: You understand what quality measures actually measure at the bedside, can distinguish clinically meaningful patterns from noise, and translate findings into language clinicians trust and act on.

## Roadmap: Healthcare Cybersecurity Analyst
URL: /r/healthcare-cybersecurity-analyst
Difficulty: High
Timeline: 6 to 12 months
Target: Healthcare professionals transitioning to cybersecurity analyst roles in healthcare organizations
Key Certifications: CompTIA Security+ (non-negotiable entry), CompTIA CySA+, HCISPP (sunsetting Dec 2026), CHPS
Key Skills: SIEM analysis, incident response, HIPAA Security Rule compliance, vulnerability management, network security, medical device security, threat detection, risk assessment
Clinical Advantage: You understand PHI workflows at the point of care, can assess whether security controls will disrupt patient care before deployment, and bring incident response instincts from clinical emergencies directly to cybersecurity triage.
